name: spicrawl
description: Scrape web pages to Markdown, HTML, text or JSON, run batch jobs, keep login sessions, and read request history and usage, through the hosted Spicrawl MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Scrape web pages, run batch jobs, keep login sessions
interface.longDescription: Scrape web pages to Markdown, HTML, text or JSON, run batch jobs, keep persistent login sessions, and read request history, usage and Spicrawl's docs. Needs a Spicrawl API key in SPICRAWL_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Use Spicrawl to fetch this page as Markdown and summarize it.
